data: In fiscal 2025 (year ended December 31, 2025), Tesla reported revenue of $94,827 million, gross profit of $17,094 million and income from operations of $4,355 million. That works out to a gross margin of about 18.0% and an operating margin of about 4.6%. For comparison, fiscal 2024 had revenue of $97,690 million, gross profit of $17,450 million (17.9% margin) and operating income of $7,076 million (7.2% margin). So gross margin was roughly flat year over year, while operating margin fell by about 2.6 percentage points, mainly because operating expenses rose from $10,374 million to $12,739 million, driven by research and development increasing from $4,540 million to $6,411 million.
